svg.aria-label: The maximum requests per second the feed endpoint could serve, before and after the cache moved into the proxy. With the cache inside the application it reached about 1,200 requests a second. With the same rule in Nginx it reached more than 10,800, roughly nine times as much. Beneath, the system ceiling over the same change moved only from four thousand to five thousand two hundred and fifty users, about 1.3 times. The caption explains that these are two different ceilings, that a nine-fold gain on one endpoint produced a one-point-three-fold gain overall because the rest of the work did not get faster, and that this gap is the ordinary shape of optimising one part of a system.
svg.text: TWO DIFFERENT CEILINGS, AND ONLY ONE OF THEM MOVED NINEFOLD
